R01.name: Brightness rule
R01.text: At most one large B03 block per screen (the main card). Otherwise B03 only appears on switches that are on, progress bars, status dots and active icon tiles. Text on a B03 block uses ink M0 #0D1D2A.

R02.name: One accent
R02.text: Each screen uses one main accent color. Other B colors are only for secondary states.

R03.name: Background hierarchy
R03.text: The higher a layer sits, the lighter its background: N0 app background, N1 surface, N2 card, N3 icon tile inside a card.

R04.name: 3-level hierarchy
R04.text: Every KV has exactly 3 reading levels: the largest headline (read in 1 second), a subhead at least 2 type steps smaller, and a CTA that stands out in the accent color.

R05.name: Safe area
R05.text: Keep text and logo at least 5–8% of the short side away from the edges. Stories/Reels keep 250px clear top and bottom. Facebook covers keep key content in the central 820px.

R06.name: Text contrast
R06.text: Body text needs at least 4.5:1 contrast with its background; large text over 24px at least 3:1. Text over photos needs a dark overlay or a solid block.

R07.name: Max 2 fonts
R07.text: Use at most 2 font families: one for headings, one for body. Create contrast with size and weight instead of adding fonts.

R08.name: 60-30-10 color ratio
R08.text: 60% dominant color (background), 30% secondary (blocks, imagery), 10% accent (CTA, highlights). Use the accent only for the most important thing.

R09.name: Logo & identity
R09.text: Place the logo in one fixed corner (usually top-left or bottom-right), about 8–12% of the width, with clear space around it equal to the cap height.

R10.name: One main idea
R10.text: Each KV carries one main message and has one first focal point. Secondary information goes in the caption or landing page.

R11.name: Vietnamese text
R11.text: Only use fonts with full Vietnamese accent support for accented text. Check ư, ơ, ặ, ỗ, ữ before locking the font.

R12.name: Snappy feedback
R12.text: Hover and press feedback runs in 100–200ms with ease-out. Entrance animations max 400ms. Avoid slow, sluggish motion.

R13.name: 8pt spacing grid
R13.value: all spacing is a multiple of 4/8
R13.text: All spacing, padding and sizes use multiples of 8 (4 allowed for small details). No odd values like 13px or 27px.

R14.name: 44px touch targets
R14.text: Tappable buttons and icons on mobile have at least a 44 × 44px target and 8px between them.

R15.name: One primary button per screen
R15.value: primary stands out, the rest are secondary
R15.text: Each screen or KV has one primary button (solid, accent color). Other actions use outline buttons or links.

R16.name: One radius family
R16.text: Pick one radius set (e.g. 8/16/24) and use it everywhere. Nested blocks: inner radius equals outer radius minus padding.

R17.name: Dark mode: higher is lighter
R17.text: In dark UI, show elevation with progressively lighter surfaces (#0B0B10 → #15151C → #1E1E27 → #2A2A36), not only shadows.

R18.name: Glass needs contrast
R18.text: Use frosted glass only over color or imagery. Text on glass needs ≥ 4.5:1 contrast; add a dark tint if needed.

R19.name: Respect reduced motion
R19.value: turn off motion when users ask
R19.text: When the OS has reduced motion on (prefers-reduced-motion), disable looping and large animations; keep only color changes.
